en: Black‑and‑white postcard with two photographic views. The main image shows a railway station and level crossing beside multiple tracks, with telegraph poles, gas-style lamps, and several people near a barrier gate. Across the road is a tree‑lined square with a large, simple masonry building that looks like a public or municipal building. A sign near the crossing reads "EINGANG". The inset image at the lower left shows a two‑storey rectangular building with the words "STADT DÜDEN?" (partly obscured) on its facade, with horses and carriages in front. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene focused on the station area and adjacent civic building.
